opening.text: I'm here because my heart feels like it's beating very irregularly, in a disorganised way. I also feel slightly dizzy or lightheaded, and these symptoms get worse when I exert myself and ease off when I rest. I have severe COPD, a known problem with one of my heart valves, and I have high blood pressure or take medicine for it.
